endpoints.sourceText:
sourceVersion: 1
kind: endpoint
id: load-profile
name: Load Profile
description: Return the caller's players record.
exposure: public
method: POST
input:
  type: object
  properties: {}
steps:
  - id: profile
    type: read
    collection: players
    key: "{{steamId}}"
response:
  status: 200
  body:
    ok: true
    profile: "{{profile}}"

sourceVersion: 1
kind: endpoint
id: save-profile
name: Save Profile
description: Save non-economic profile state.
exposure: public
method: POST
input:
  type: object
  properties:
    playerName:
      type: string
  required: [ playerName ]
steps:
  - id: save
    type: write
    collection: players
    key: "{{steamId}}"
    ops:
      - op: set
        path: playerName
        value: "{{input.playerName}}"
response:
  status: 200
  body:
    ok: true

sourceVersion: 1
kind: endpoint
id: mine-ore
name: Mine Ore
description: Adds ore after validating the amount.
exposure: public
method: POST
input:
  type: object
  properties:
    amount:
      type: number
  required: [ amount ]
steps:
  - id: player
    type: read
    collection: players
    key: "{{steamId}}"
  - id: positive_amount
    type: condition
    check:
      field: "{{input.amount}}"
      op: ">"
      value: 0
    routes:
      false:
        action: reject
        status: 400
        error: INVALID_AMOUNT
        message: Amount must be positive.
  - id: apply
    type: write
    collection: players
    key: "{{steamId}}"
    ops:
      - op: inc
        path: ores.stone
        value: "{{input.amount}}"
response:
  status: 200
  body:
    ok: true
    mined: "{{input.amount}}"

sourceVersion: 1
kind: endpoint
id: buy-upgrade
name: Buy Upgrade
description: Workflow-backed purchase priced from the upgrades game-values table.
exposure: public
method: POST
input:
  type: object
  properties:
    upgradeId:
      type: string
  required: [ upgradeId ]
steps:
  - id: player
    type: read
    collection: players
    key: "{{steamId}}"
  - id: upgrade
    type: lookup
    source: values
    table: upgrades
    required: true
    onMissing:
      status: 400
      errorCode: UNKNOWN_UPGRADE
      message: Unknown upgrade.
    where:
      field: id
      op: ==
      value: "{{input.upgradeId}}"
  - id: pricing
    type: workflow
    workflow: scaled-cost
    params:
      baseCost: "{{upgrade.baseCost}}"
      costGrowth: "{{upgrade.costGrowth}}"
      currentValue: "{{player.level}}"
  - id: afford
    type: workflow
    workflow: check-currency
    params:
      balance: "{{player.gold}}"
      cost: "{{pricing.cost}}"
  - id: charge
    type: write
    collection: players
    key: "{{steamId}}"
    ops:
      - op: inc
        path: gold
        value: "{{pricing.negCost}}"
      - op: set
        path: level
        value: "{{pricing.nextValue}}"
response:
  status: 200
  body:
    ok: true
    cost: "{{pricing.cost}}"
    level: "{{pricing.nextValue}}"

workflows.sourceText:
sourceVersion: 1
kind: workflow
id: scaled-cost
name: Scaled Cost
description: Compute an exponential purchase cost for the next level.
definition:
  params:
    baseCost:
      type: number
    costGrowth:
      type: number
    currentValue:
      type: number
  steps:
    - id: current_value
      type: transform
      expression: "max(0, {{currentValue}})"
    - id: cost
      type: transform
      expression: "ceil({{baseCost}} * pow({{costGrowth}}, {{current_value}}))"
    - id: neg_cost
      type: transform
      expression: "0 - {{cost}}"
    - id: next_value
      type: transform
      expression: "{{current_value}} + 1"
  returns:
    cost: "{{cost}}"
    negCost: "{{neg_cost}}"
    nextValue: "{{next_value}}"

sourceVersion: 1
kind: workflow
id: check-currency
name: Check Currency
description: Validate that a player has enough currency for a cost.
definition:
  params:
    balance:
      type: number
    cost:
      type: number
  steps:
    - id: has_currency
      type: condition
      check:
        field: "{{balance}}"
        op: ">="
        value: "{{cost}}"
      onFail:
        status: 409
        error: INSUFFICIENT_CURRENCY
        message: Not enough currency.
  returns:
    ok: true
